reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Proposed target-cell somatic calcium-imaging calibration against paired electrophysiology, structural 3D motion reference, neuropil/expression sensitivity and visual-response validation.

checks.quote: # Proposed Calibration and Validation Protocol for a GECI as a Spike-Inference Reporter
checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation of prior paired-imaging/electrophysiology Methods, supplements or validated protocols to choose conditions and verify transfer.

checks.quote: # Proposed Calibration and Validation Protocol for a GECI as a Spike-Inference Reporter
checks.reason: Indicator preparation/delivery lacks quantitative amount/timing or a concrete procedure deriving those conditions before confirmation.

checks.quote: # Proposed Calibration and Validation Protocol for a GECI as a Spike-Inference Reporter
checks.reason: No reproducible event-to-spike matching tolerance and false-positive time/window denominator, including missing-frame and residual calcium history handling.

checks.quote: enough cells per target cell type
checks.reason: The pilot computes a cell target; independent animal replication/cluster variance is not incorporated into the precision-to-allocation procedure, despite an animal random effect being mentioned.

checks.quote: exclude epochs where residual motion correlation with the GECI signal exceeds
checks.reason: Real behavior-linked firing can correlate with movement. Excluding on residual functional correlation without conditioning on paired neural ground truth can select away true activity or hard performance cases.

checks.quote: # Proposed Calibration and Validation Protocol for a GECI as a Spike-Inference Reporter
checks.reason: No operational visual-response test or multiplicity handling is specified for the several stimulus/cell response claims.

checks.quote: This controls for how much indicator is present.
checks.reason: The baseline functional/structural ratio is a proxy influenced by resting calcium and marker abundance, not an identified control for indicator amount. The transfer-function interpretation needs that limitation.

checks.quote: across a plausible range
checks.reason: No bounded coefficient search or procedure deriving its limits/grid before selecting the operating setting.

checks.quote: # Proposed Calibration and Validation Protocol for a GECI as a Spike-Inference Reporter
checks.reason: No explicit fresh independent confirmation after diagnostic repairs and refreezing changed conditions.

checks.quote: # Proposed Calibration and Validation Protocol for a GECI as a Spike-Inference Reporter
checks.reason: Blinded analysis is present, but the fitted transfer function and chosen correction/threshold lack an untouched independent validation partition.

checks.quote: # Proposed Calibration and Validation Protocol for a GECI as a Spike-Inference Reporter
checks.reason: No complete stable sample/event/raw-file linkage and exact software/environment/version manifest.

checks.quote: # Proposed Calibration and Validation Protocol for a GECI as a Spike-Inference Reporter
checks.reason: The proposed same-cell recordings, structural 3D reference, interference checks, nonlinear transfer function, randomized blocks and artifact troubleshooting are useful. Causal comparison is weakened by outcome-related epoch selection and absence of held-out validation. Expression ratios require a proxy interpretation.
